before: A list level with empty number text ignored its suffix and its first-line or hanging indent, so the first line always started at the text indent.
after: A list level with empty number text holds a zero-width number at its slot, and the tab, space, or no suffix places the first line from there.
reason: This changes line placement in layout only. Canonical nodes, operations, stored fields, and collaboration messages are unchanged, and every participant computes the same layout from the same tree.
